title: Swipe to archive
description: Expose a destructive or secondary action through a deliberate horizontal gesture.
useCase: Expose a destructive or secondary action through a deliberate horizontal gesture.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Local archive state. A reveal button and archive button provide a complete keyboard alternative.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a white rounded inbox card holding one message row with a beige initials avatar, grey preview text and chevron.
motion: Dragging the row left reveals a green archive action; release snaps it open at 64 px or closed, and past 75 px it slides off and fades (220 ms ease-out).
adapt: Gesture logic is in the `mail-row` pointer handlers (-100 clamp, -75 archive and -30 snap thresholds, -64 open offset); settling is its 220 ms transition. Replace the sender and subject, wire `setArchived` to a real action, and keep the reveal and Undo buttons.
